track_name: Donington Park Racing Circuit - Grand Prix
title: iRacing F4 Donington Full - 1:27.5 (Fixed) - F4 Donington Full Track Guide eSports Series

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: braking up to about 60% drop it down to third long trail off very slightly on exit

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: just before the turn right sign, that's when we're going to go on the brakes which are about 30%
corners.exit: back on the gas nice and early

corners.braking: braking up to about 40% quick trail off down to fourth gear again
corners.exit: exit wide, but not too wide

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: braking up to about 40% back on the gas
braking marker is just as it starts moving off to the right-hand side, 30%
corners.line: do the first curb and then left-hand tires as it moves back round
corners.exit: exit nice and wide, keep center of car over rumble strip, flat through five and six

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: end of curbing on left-hand side, 55%
corners.mistakes: blip before dropping to fourth to avoid back end doing anything silly

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: Brake at top of hill, 3 car lengths before, 50% then trail off
corners.mistakes: Lose time by not taking enough speed in

corners.braking: Brake as soon as dropping down hill, 70%

corners.line: trail brakes to apex, wide exit

general_tips: So much time can be found there through turn eight Coppice.
Don't over brake for the esses.
